texts.facts: The petitioners are manufacturers of tobacco products, such as Pan Masala and Zarda. The petitioners are aggrieved by the orders of the Commissioner of Food Safety, Patna, whereby the Commissioner, in exercise of powers, under Section 30(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, has prohibited the manufacture, storage, distribution or sale of Zarda, Pan Masala and Gutkha.
